message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) resulted in roughly **23,000–25,000 total casualties** across all sides:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch, Prussian, etc.) | ~23,000 |
| French | ~25,000 |

These figures combine killed, wounded, and missing soldiers from both the Allied coalition and the French army.
